description: Build for production and return the size report (raw, gzip, brotli per file). `leaks` lists dev-only code found in the output; it must be empty. `saves` compares the game's saves with saves.json: an error means players would lose saved progress. Don't accept save changes yourself; tell the human (they run `debuff build --accept-saves`).

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.
